advice.headline: Make a trade

moves.text: Offer Straight Outta Hampton: Tre' Harris + Chase Brown for Isaiah Likely.
Pick up Elijah Higgins off waivers (+1.5 points a week) and drop Matt Hibner.

reasons: You're 15-5 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 27%.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 1st of 8 contenders (180.5 points a week).
Your weakest position is WR (11th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 1st in 2026, 1st in 2027 and 1st in 2028 (title chances about 27%, 26%, 28%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 27% to 30%, and your lineup comes out 1.5 points a week ahead overall. Tre' Harris + Chase Brown add 5.5 points a week for you today, but Isaiah Likely is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 4,567, get 4,276), and it helps their lineup too (+0.6 a week), which makes it an easy sell.
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 26% and 28% to 26% and 28%.
You have 3 weeks until the trade deadline.
watch: Week 11 is your weakest projected week (146 points vs your usual 174), mostly byes.
D'Andre Swift's trade value has dropped 35% in 30 days.
Jordan Love's trade value has dropped 17% in 30 days.
Chase Brown's trade value has dropped 34% in 30 days.
Bryce Young's trade value has dropped 42% in 30 days.
